worldcombat.skill.constrict.summary: Creeping vines or tentacles crawl to the target, wrap around it and squeeze. The damage is tiny; the value is what comes after — a Speed drop and a brief hold, handing the target to an ally or to the user's next move. It may also tighten once more for an extra Speed stage.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.use.1: Pin a foe in place for an ally
worldcombat.skill.constrict.use.2: Leave a lasting slow on a foe at the lowest cost
The squeeze deals about %1$s points of contact damage, reaching %2$s blocks; the tendril crawls to the target at %3$s blocks per tick. If the target has left that reach by the time the tendril arrives, the grab misses.

A bound target loses %1$s Speed stages and stays wrapped for %2$s seconds (about 30% lower movement speed); it is also rooted for %3$s seconds and cannot move. There is a %4$s chance to tighten for one more Speed stage.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.latch.on: Latch form: binds and holds far longer and drops one more Speed stage, but deals less damage and the user commits limbs to hold it, unable to move for a moment.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.latch.off: Squeeze form: a heavier, quicker crush with a shorter bind and hold.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it costs %4$s PP to cast, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.growth.0: At level %1$s, the squeeze power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.growth.1: At level %1$s, the squeeze power rises to %2$s and the Speed drop to %3$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.preference.l: On: binds and holds far longer and drops one more Speed stage, but deals less damage and the user commits limbs to hold it, unable to move for a moment. Off (squeeze): a heavier, quicker crush with a shorter bind and hold.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.preference.a: It will not reach out beyond this distance; it closes in first. This is a close grapple, so a larger value mostly invites misses while chasing.
On: fast-moving or fleeing targets rank higher, so it pins them down first. Off: it only ranks by threat and distance.
